_comment: Confirmed French extras: our food name -> the Ciqual alim_nom_eng it lends a column to. These foods already have Livsmedelsverket figures and keep every one of them. Only lactose and polyols are taken, because Livsmedelsverket publishes neither for any food, so no Swedish round can ever fill them.
Apples: Apple, Canada, flesh without skin, raw
Cream Cheese (<10% fat): Fresh cream cheese, petit-suisse type, plain, around 4% fat
Cream Cheese (>10% fat): Fresh cream cheese, petit-suisse type, plain, around 10% fat
Flavored Yogurt: Yoghurtor fermented milk, plain or with fruits (average)
Hard Cheese (~15% fat): Hard cheese, emmental-type cheese, reduced fat, from cow's milk
Lactose-free Cheese: Emmental cheese, from cow's milk, from Savoy
